messages:
Alex: small PR touching logging config and a tiny helper in model-service, requesting quick merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234 :wave:
Alex: AFAICT CODEOWNERS points model-service at @eng-runtime and logging config at @eng-infra, so two approvals required. Can someone advise if we can get a single approver or proxy?
Priya: if it's just a docs-ish config tweak + a 3-line helper, I'd be fine to approve but not listed in CODEOWNERS. :thinking_face:
Miguel: can you paste the CODEOWNERS lines? quick check re: scope.
Alex: sure — snippet:
```
# CODEOWNERS
/services/model-service/ @eng-runtime
/config/logging/* @eng-infra
```
Alex: the PR modifies services/model-service/utils/logging_helper.py and config/logging/default.yaml
Jordan: hm that is cross-area. usual rule is both owners must approve unless an owner has explicitly delegated.
Lina: I'm on infra rotation but knee-deep in a pager until 11. If Priya is comfortable reviewing the model-service change and it's really trivial I can do a quick infra ack after pager clears.
Priya: took a quick look — helper is small, tests included. I can review and approve the model-service side now. :white_check_mark:
Alex: thanks! Lina, do you mind adding a comment "infra ack" so bots pick it up?
Lina: will do when free. @deploy-bot any chance to let a single approval flow if an infra ack comment exists?
deploy-bot: Pipelines: there is no automatic single-approval override for CODEOWNERS. Manual proxy approvals allowed by org policy: ping a team lead or add a temporary codeowners exception PR.
Miguel: alternative: make the change in two commits/PRs (one for logging config, one for helper). But that's a hassle.
Jordan: pragmatic path: Priya approves (model-service), Lina posts ack comment when unblocked, then Alex asks a maintainer (miguel or jordan) to click merge after verifying infra ack. Maintainers can bypass in emergencies.
Alex: @Miguel can you be the merge maintainer if Lina posts ack? It's Friday and we'd like to ship today.
Miguel: sure, I can spot-check and merge once I see Lina's ack.
Alex: perfect — I'll mark the PR with "ready for merge - infra ack pending" and ping Lina.
Lina: ack posted: "infra ack — config change is fine from infra side, small YAML default change" :thumbsup:
Alex: PR updated with Lina's comment and linking to this thread. Priya approved, Miguel can you merge when green?
Miguel: LGTM, tests passing. merging now. :shipit:
Alex: thanks everyone!
